name: returnsTrueForSingleValidShortOption
expected: Returns true because it starts with '-', has length > 1, and options.hasShortOption("a") is true.

name: returnsFalseWhenTokenDoesNotStartWithHyphen
expected: Returns false because the token does not start with '-'.

name: returnsTrueForShortOptionWithValueSeparator
expected: Returns true because optName extracted before '=' is "a" and options.hasShortOption("a") is true.

name: returnsTrueForConcatenatedShortOptions
expected: Returns true because the first character of optName ("abc") is "a", which is a valid short option.

name: returnsFalseForUnknownShortOption
input: token = "-x", options does not contain short option "x"
expected: Returns false because neither the full optName nor its first character corresponds to a registered short option.

name: returnsFalseForLongOptionStartingWithDoubleHyphen
input: token = "--long", options does not contain short option "-long"
expected: Returns false because optName becomes "-long", which is not a short option and its first char '-' is also not a valid short option.

name: returnsFalseWhenOptNameIsEmptyAfterHyphenStripping
expected: Returns false because optName extraction results in empty string, leading to false on hasShortOption checks.

name: returnsTrueWhenFirstCharOfConcatenatedOptIsRegistered
input: token = "-xyz", options contains short option "x", but not "xyz"
expected: Returns true because optName length > 0 and options.hasShortOption(String.valueOf(optName.charAt(0))) evaluates to true.

name: returnsFalseWhenFirstCharOfConcatenatedOptIsNotRegistered
expected: Returns false because both full optName check and first-character check fail against the options registry.

name: returnsTrueForShortOptionWithValueAndEqualsSignInValue
expected: Returns true because indexOf("=") correctly isolates the first '=' to extract optName as "a".

name: returnsFalseForNullToken
expected: Throws NullPointerException because token.startsWith("-") is invoked on a null reference.
